name: telmoni-observability
description: Records each turn of your Codex sessions in Telmoni as a run: the models, their tokens, the tools and the times. Never a prompt, a reply, a thought, a tool's input or output, or a path.

interface.shortDescription: Each turn of your Codex sessions recorded in Telmoni, metadata only
interface.longDescription: Records each turn of your Codex sessions in Telmoni as a run: the models it called and their tokens, the tools it used, each with its times and whether it failed. Never a prompt, a reply, a thought, a tool's input or output, a command, a path or the folder you work in.
